name: National Institute of Family and Life Advocates v. Becerra
summary: The Supreme Court struck down a California law requiring pro-life pregnancy centers to provide certain notices, holding that there is no separate, lower First Amendment standard for 'professional speech' and that content-based regulations must satisfy strict scrutiny.
significance: Petitioners rely on this case for the principle that content-based regulations of speech — including in professional settings — are presumptively unconstitutional and subject to strict scrutiny, rejecting the idea that professional speech receives lesser First Amendment protection.
